rights.evidence: GitHub repository description says the models are extracted from Pokemon HOME. No README or license file exists at the pinned commit. Files are retained only in ignored data/local for source inspection and are excluded from runtime catalog, public, dist, and deployment.

selection.rule: Choose non-rare pmNNNN_00_00.glb when present; otherwise choose the lexicographically lowest non-rare form code and record it explicitly.

textureAudit.method: Inspect the pinned recursive repository tree for common texture image extensions, then inspect each selected GLB JSON chunk for images, textures, material names, and material texture references.
textureAudit.conclusion: No texture image files exist in the pinned repository tree, and none of the 54 selected GLBs contains an image, texture object, external image URI, or material texture reference. No texture files were downloaded.
